name: witness
description: Keeps a ledger of what you asked for and counts it done only on evidence: claims stay pale until a read-back confirms them, bare SQL UPDATE or DELETE writes are held for your answer, and a print of what was and was not witnessed goes into the session log.

body.title: Body
body.description: The companion's body: phi (nautilus) or phial (round-bottom flask).

watchHold.title: Hold the first prompt until the watch is taken
watchHold.description: On session start, and after five idle minutes, ask before the prompt goes through. Off by default.

ticketScript.title: Ticket script
ticketScript.description: Path of the script that prints a status ticket as JSON (relative to the session folder, or absolute). Empty: scripts/estate-status.py beside the mod, and no ticket when it is absent.

watchScript.title: Watch script
watchScript.description: Path of the script that reads the board for the watch and its poll. Empty: scripts/witness-watch.py in the mod's own repository, and no watch or poll when it is absent.

writerCalls.title: Writer calls
writerCalls.description: Comma-separated SQL functions a SELECT calls to write (schema.name; a trailing * matches any suffix). Default: the author's workspace functions, harmless where that schema does not exist.
writerCalls.default: workspace.close_todo, workspace.set_todo_status, workspace.pause_todo, workspace.crosstalk_*, workspace.record_board_attention, workspace.claim_item, workspace.release_claim

person.title: Your name
person.description: How the print and the confirm tool name you. Default: you ("on your words"; the model reads "the user").

sessionsDir.title: Session log folder
sessionsDir.description: Where session logs live, relative to the session folder.

goalsHeading.title: Goals heading
goalsHeading.description: The session log heading whose checkbox items are the goals.

closeCommands.title: Close commands
closeCommands.description: Comma-separated commands that close a session; the print is written before they run.
